# DSH ChatChat source provenance

DSH ChatChat adapts DS-Bot, commit `84c3cb86b997aec53281b842fd162f3f6b4ee7be`, from <https://github.com/Fei-Craft/DS-Bot>. The repository was originally published as `Fei2411/DS-Bot` and has moved to the `Fei-Craft` organization.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Its unmodified LICENSE and NOTICE are retained beside this file. DSH ChatChat is an independent plugin, with changes described in [MODIFICATIONS.md](../../MODIFICATIONS.md) and the local Git history. Compatibility identifiers do not imply shared branding or distribution with a host product.
